turns.replyText:
I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you; when you’ve been let down before, it makes choosing the next plant feel a lot riskier. You’re right to be picky.

A quick overview of what you can expect from us:

All our roses are premium own-root plants grown in Oregon, not bare root, and are true to variety and virus-free.
We defoliate before shipping so they travel well and then leaf out again after planting.
Every rose and plant is backed by a guarantee (1 year for roses, 90 days for perennials, and a failure-to-bloom guarantee for bulbs).

To make sure we dial in the right choice for you, can you tell me the main thing you’re shopping for right now (for example: a specific type of rose, a climber for a fence, something very fragrant, or a plant for a certain sun/shade spot)?
